L1·N7741unmasked layer
Fires on word-continuation/ending sub-word fragments inside non-English (Romanian/French/German) words and loanwords — e.g. the "eti" of *puteti*, the "ame" of *Notre-Dame*, the elision apostrophe in *s'effectuent*, " mar" of *marquée*, " air" of *plein air* — i.e. a morphological word-completion position rather than any semantic content (word-initial fragments like "un" in *propuneri* or "oman" in *Risikomanagement* drive it strongly negative).
